title: EgerTickets
subtitle: Egerton University Event Ticketing Platform
desc: Egerton University's official event ticketing and discovery platform. Students can browse and book campus events across music, sports, concerts, conferences, and workshops — with secure checkout in seconds. Features an AI assistant chatbot, real-time event dashboards, an organizer portal, and a full booking management system.

title: M-Pesa Ticketing System
subtitle: Mobile Payment Integration
desc: Full-stack payment integration for events using Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB. Handles secure M-Pesa STK Push transactions, callback processing, and real-time payment confirmation for Kenyan users.

title: EESA Dashboard
subtitle: Engineering Student Association Portal
desc: Association management system for engineering students. Features member tracking, event management, communication tools, and committee coordination for EESA operations.

title: Salsa Rhythm App
subtitle: Dance Progress Tracker
desc: A creative mobile app for tracking dance progress with video tutorials, progress logging, social sharing, and community features for salsa enthusiasts.
